summary.text: Your child may take either parent's race, an acceptable mixed race, or, if a Singapore citizen, both parents' races.

details.heading: Available race choices
details.body: Your child can follow either parent's race. If you and your spouse have different races, your child may also have an acceptable mixed race. If your child is a Singapore citizen, a double-barrelled race using both parents' races is also available.

details.heading: For siblings
details.body: All children below 21 from the same parents should have the same race.

example_phrasings: What are the race options available for my child if my spouse and I are of different races?
What race can my child have if we are different races?
Can my child use either parent's race?

sources.page_title: What are the race options available for my child if my spouse and I are of different races?

quotes.text: The race of a child can follow that of either parent, or an acceptable mixed race if the child's parents are of different races.
A child who is a Singapore citizen is also eligible to have a double-barrelled race comprising both parents’ races.
All siblings of the child who are below 21 years old from the same set of parents should have the same race.
